title: The pro-ui-b job hits its 60 minute cap: raise the cap, or split the job
why: The pro-ui-b job hit its 60 minute cap on main (run 43769323418, main 9b7c4e4d) and on PR 238 (run 43762232891). It was cancelled inside PackageStamp, so PackagesShell, Step7DesignShots, SyncAdvisory, TallyCopyStepper, Tally and Versions have never run green on any tree.
note: CI lane, not started (coordinator, 2026-11-15 18:00 CST). No owner ruling is needed to raise the cap: claude-settings decision ci-job-caps (owner, 2026-11-01 18:44 CST, widened 2026-11-10 12:11 CST) has every owner repo raise its CI job caps generously as a stopgap, and its target is a slowest run under 80% of the cap. Splitting the job is the lane's choice in the workflow file. PR 238 stays a draft: 12 tests are new on it and 6 are unknown. The baseline PR 341 is closed.
